product.title: Great Ocean Road Tour Plus Koalas, Forest Walk and Morning Tea

description.text: In Melbourne, this Great Ocean Road day includes morning tea and published stops at Kennett River, Apollo Bay, Gibsons Steps, the Twelve Apostles, and Loch Ard Gorge. The public page lists a forest walk among tall trees and koala spotting rather than a reverse luxury-bus timing. The format suits visitors who want wildlife and morning tea on the coast without a Grampians lookout hike. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Melbourne, including The Great Southern Hotel on Spencer Street, and the itinerary stays on those coastal stops that define this outing rather than a Balgownie Estate balloon.

highlights: Gibsons Steps and the Twelve Apostles

start.description: Pick up from your choice of Melbourne CBD approximately 7am, or meet at The Great Southern Hotel Melbourne, 44 Spencer St, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
